Singh (Chairman)|Vikas Gupta (CEO)|Sandeep Singh (MD){{cite web|url=https://www.alkemlabs.com/board-directors|title=Board of Directors|work=Alkem}}}} | subsidiaries = Pharmacor Limited, Connect2clinic, Alkem Foundation{{cite web | url=https://www.alkemlabs.com/investors/subsidiary-accounts | title=Alkem - Subsidiary Financial Statements }} | products = {{ubl |[[Pharmaceutical]]s |[[Generic drug]]s |[[Over-the-counter drug]]s |[[Vaccine]]s |[[Medical diagnosis|Diagnostics]] |[[Contact lens]]es |[[Veterinary medicine|animal health]] }} | services = | revenue = {{increase}} {{INRConvert|12964|c}} (2025) | operating_income = {{increase}} {{INRConvert|2512|c}} (2025) | net_income = {{increase}} {{INRConvert|2165|c}} (2025) | assets = {{increase}} {{INRConvert|17691|c}} (2025) | equity = {{increase}} {{INRConvert|12433|c}} (2025) | num_employees = 24,000 (2026){{cite web|url=https://admin.alkemlabs.com/uploads/alkem_labs_ar_2023_24_C2_C_26_07_2024_high_res_1890c8a8ec.pdf|title=Alkem Laboratories Limited Annual Report 2024|publisher=Alkem Laboratories Limited|accessdate=2 July 2020}} | owner = | website = {{URL|http://www.alkemlabs.com/}} | footnotes = Financials {{as of|2025|03|31|lc=y|df=yes}}.{{cite web |title=Q4 and FY25 Investor Presentation |url=https://admin.alkemlabs.com/uploads/Q4_FY_25_Investor_Presentation_0e15356dbe.pdf |publisher=Alkem Labs |access-date=3 July 2025}}{{cite web |title=Statement of Consolidated Assets and Liabilities as at 31 March 2025 |url=https://admin.alkemlabs.com/uploads/Alkem_Outcomeof_Board_Meeting29052025_92bc0b0849.pdf |publisher=Alkem Labs |access-date=3 July 2025}} }} '''Alkem Laboratories Limited''' is an Indian multinational [[pharmaceutical]] company headquartered in [[Mumbai]]. Specialising in [[Generic drug|generics]] and speciality pharmaceuticals, Alkem manufactures and markets pharmaceutical generics, [[Pharmaceutical formulation|formulations]] and [[nutraceutical]]s across India and global markets. ==History== [[Samprada Singh]] was the founder and chairman emeritus of the company; he had a [[B.Com]] degree from [[Patna University]]. His brother, Basudeo Narayan Singh, was also the co-founder of the company.{{cite web|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/profiles/people/17629983-basudeo-narain-singh|title=Basudeo Singh|publisher=Bloomberg}} Alkem set up its research and development facility for [[Abbreviated New Drug Application|ANDA]] development at [[Taloja Panchnand railway station|Taloja]] in 2003.{{Cite news |title=Alkem Laboratories Ltd. (ALKEM) – Company History |work=Business Standard India |url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/alkem-lab-19299/information/company-history |access-date=31 May 2022}} In 2006 anti-infective drug Taxim of Alkem became the first anti-infective drug in the Indian pharmaceutical industry to cross 1,000 million in terms of domestic sales in India.{{Cite web |title=Alkem Laboratories History {{!}} Alkem Laboratories Information |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/alkem-laboratories-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-15059.cms |access-date=31 May 2022 |website=The Economic Times |language=en}} In 2014 Clavam another drug from Alkem crossed 2,000 million mark in terms of domestic sales in India.{{Citation needed|date=March 2026}} In 2007 the company filed its first ANDA for drug [[Amlodipine]] which was approved in 2009. Alkem has developed a portfolio of 705 branded generic drugs, with 13 of the brands featured among the top 300 brands in India for the fiscal year 2015 and a portfolio of 705 brands in India in the six months ended 30 September 2015. Alkem have 21 manufacturing facilities, 19 in India and 2 in US. 5 of the facilities are US [[Food and Drug Administration|FDA]], [[Therapeutic Goods Administration|TGA]], UK [[Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency|MHRA]] approved.{{Citation needed|date=March 2026}} Samprada Singh (1925–2019) died on 27 July 2019 at the age of 94 after a brief illness in Mumbai.{{cite news|url=https://business.medicaldialogues.in/alkem-labs-founder-samprada-singh-passes-away-at-the-age-of-92-years/|title= Alkem Labs Founder Samprada Singh passes away at the age of 92 years|date=27 July 2019|work=Medical Dialogues}} In 2018, he was the 46th richest person in India.{{cite web|url=https://www.forbes.com/profile/samprada-singh/|title=Samprada Singh & family|work=Forbes}} == Acquisitions == Alkem has 21 manufacturing facilities: 19 in India and 2 in the US.{{Cite web |date=6 May 2022 |title=List of Top Largest Pharmaceutical Companies in India [Updated 2022-2023] |url=https://www.edudwar.com/top-pharma-companies-in-india/ |access-date=31 May 2022 |website=Edudwar |language=en-US |archive-date=31 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230531120442/https://www.edudwar.com/top-pharma-companies-in-india/ |url-status=dead }} These 2 facilities in the US were acquired in 2012 and 2013 respectively. In 2014, Alkem acquired the "Clindac-A" brand in India from [[Galderma]] S.A. In 2015, Alkem acquired a formulation manufacturing facility in the US.{{Cite web |last=Balakrishnan |first=Reghu |date=25 November 2015 |title=Alkem plans to double US revenue by 2020, launch IPO in December |url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/ze93IFa4flb19eFZE0WLSP/Alkems-IPO-to-hit-in-December-plans-to-double-US-revenue-b.html |access-date=31 May 2022 |website=mint |language=en}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== * {{official website|https://www.alkemlabs.com/}} {{Nifty 200 companies}} [[Category:Pharmaceutical companies of India]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies based in Mumbai]] [[Category:Indian brands]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1973]] [[Category:1973 establishments in Maharashtra]] [[Category:Pharmaceutical companies established in 1973]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Multinational companies headquartered in India]] {{India-company-stub}}
